ms.report:
Based on the reviewer's feedback, the new close-out report specifies:
・An explanation of how each deliverable of the proposal has been completed and reported (beta testing, lead generation, adoption and implementation, and design and prototyping). 
・Here is a link to the current implementation of Gimbalabs's contribution platform (also included in the close-out report). This platform includes a treasury that distributes funds as tasks are completed. 

The close-out video report includes a complete walkthrough of the project as well as several videos with tutorials, platform walkthroughs, and other relevant information. 
Please note that the LMS side of the system has been functional since the first milestone; this was reported at the time. Unfortunately, our blockchain query provider (Dandelion) is currently down due to the recent problems with the testnet network. We are working to have a version working with Maestro up and running as soon as possible.
